# AlveoForge

> AlveoForge deterministically generates production-ready Java (Spring Boot) backends from a SQL schema: real hexagonal architecture with vertical slicing, full CRUD, JWT authentication, database migrations and a four-layer test suite at 95–100% coverage. Hours, not months. You see it running on your own schema, with Swagger and test reports, before you pay.

## What AlveoForge is

- A deterministic backend generator: the same SQL schema always produces the same code. No LLM, no output that drifts between runs.
- Output: Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1, real hexagonal architecture with vertical slicing (one self-contained slice per entity), deployable as a modular monolith or as microservices from the same schema.
- Included per entity: full CRUD with bulk operations and relationship expansion (`?expand`, up to two levels by default), JWT authentication with password hashing and refresh tokens, Flyway or Liquibase migrations (adopts an existing database — brownfield supported), tested HTTP contracts (success and 400 / 401 / 404 / 415), and full standard PostgreSQL type coverage (arrays, enums, JSONB, UUID, timestamptz, numeric precision, bytea, composite and foreign keys, table inheritance and partitions).
- Tests: a four-layer pyramid (unit, integration, component, end-to-end), each layer its own Maven profile, at 95–100% coverage, verified with ArchUnit and mutation testing (PIT). JaCoCo coverage and HTML test reports (Allure) ship with the delivery.
- The customer's team builds the business logic on top; new features are added as independent vertical slices.
- Validated on a real 300+ table schema.

## What AlveoForge is not

- Not an AI code assistant: generation is deterministic, not probabilistic LLM output that changes on every run.
- Does not write business logic, row-level authorization or third-party integrations. Those stay with the customer's team.
- Not a starter kit or Spring Initializr: the delivered backend is runnable and deployable, with a vertical slice per entity.
- Unrelated to AMD (Xilinx) Alveo accelerator cards, Laravel Forge, Atlassian Forge and Minecraft Forge.

## Who it is for

- Tech leads and CTOs with a legacy or stalled backend who need new features without freezing the team for a rewrite.
- Agencies that deliver backends to clients and want the same structure on every project.

## How buying works

- Priced per project on your schema (size and complexity), not per table. No public price list.
- You see your backend running on your own schema, with its Swagger and test reports, before you pay anything.
- The first payment is a down-payment, not the whole project. Fifteen days to decide on a quote.
- Delivered in a private repository. The code is fully yours, with no lock-in; the generation factory itself stays proprietary.
- 30-day post-delivery support included. Your schema is treated as confidential, and an NDA is available on request.
- Book a call: https://cal.com/alveoforge
